purpose: Inventory independently sourced Egypt research roots without promoting cross-root identity, provenance, geometry, or relic claims beyond the evidence carried by each root.

hard_firewalls: THMUIS != MENDES unless a primary-source object/site linkage is produced
INSCRIPTION_DIRECTION != EXCAVATED_POSITION unless archaeological geometry is independently documented
NAHMAN & CO. != MAURICE NAHMAN unless a primary-source identity linkage is produced
discipline.rule: UNKNOWN and NOT_DEMONSTRATED remain non-promoted until the named killer test passes.

source_lineage.named_source: Goyon PDF supplied in the research correspondence

niche_2_mapping.source_bound_meaning: fourth south; numeral reading carries uncertainty
first receptacle of Onnophris/Wennefer; no positional direction established
fourth south; numeral reading carries uncertainty
ball of He who is at the head of the Westerners; west-associated epithet is not a direct positional west marker

excluded_control.reason: Gallery 2E hallway find; not part of Niche 2 six-box set

verified_current_roots.geometry_reason: The six-box inscriptions supply explicit east x1, west x1, south x2, north x0, plus two belonging/divine-associated texts. They do not by themselves recover six archaeological placements or a complete direction-to-deity layout.
verified_current_roots.killer_test: Inspect Fichas 343-348 for independently documented archaeological positions, coordinates, plans, drawings, or in-situ photographs and compare those placements against inscription directions.

verified_current_roots.request_context: Object-level administrative provenance check for Tell Ibn Salam / Thmuis references, kept separate from any Mendes identity claim.

institutional_reply_effect.scientific_or_provenance_information: Coordinate directly with the Cairo Egyptian Museum regarding availability.
institutional_reply_effect.future_object_examination_or_publication: Return to the Permanent Committee for the formal study-request procedure if later required.

non_claims: The reply does not confirm either register entry.
The reply does not confirm object identity or findspot.
The reply does not establish a Mendes-Thmuis equivalence.
The reply is not scientific validation or access approval.
verified_current_roots.killer_test: Obtain a scan, photograph, transcription, or official museum record for TR 30/1/24/8 and TR 3/2/24/5 directly from the Cairo Egyptian Museum and compare object-level fields with the provenance index.

inventory_policy.unresolved_candidate_rule: A remembered or previously mentioned root is not promoted to a verified registry item until its exact repository artifact is fetched and inspected.
inventory_policy.cross_root_rule: No cross-root identity edge is inferred from naming similarity, geography, motifs, correspondence, or institutional routing.
